text:
maria-gonzalez: Quick PSA — onboarding README curl snippet is using a bash-only line-continuation trick that breaks when copied into PowerShell. Windows users copy/pasting the whole block often hit a "401 Bad Token" because PowerShell interprets $TOKEN and backslashes are treated differently. Example we have now:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

devon-chen: Yup, reproduced on Win11 (pwsh). If $TOKEN isn't defined pwsh will drop it so the header becomes just "Authorization: Bearer ". Also the backslash line continuation is removed when pasting which mangles the command.

samir: Suggested approach: show separate snippets for bash, PowerShell (pwsh), and cmd.exe, and add a one-line note about "Windows paste gotcha". For example pwsh should reference $env:TOKEN:

```powershell
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

For cmd.exe use %TOKEN% and for bash keep $TOKEN and the backslashes (or avoid line-continuation in examples).

jess-product: :+1: Can we also add quick lines showing how to set a temporary env var so users can copy/paste and run? e.g. `export TOKEN=...` (bash), `$env:TOKEN='...'` (pwsh), `set TOKEN=...` (cmd).

maria-gonzalez: I'll open a tiny docs PR that replaces the single bash-only block with three explicit blocks + a short "Windows paste gotcha" footnote. Will ping for review.

docs-bot: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1988 with the suggested snippets and note. Requesting review from @dev-ex.

devon-chen: LGTM, left a comment to prefer single quotes around the JSON payload so pwsh doesn't try to expand things. Small nit: also show the `$env:TOKEN` variant inside single quotes for the header.

samir: I can take a look and run a quick copy/paste test in pwsh with a dummy token to confirm no syntax errors. Also add a one-line test case to our docs checklist.

maria-gonzalez: PR merged and deployed to staging, thanks everyone :tada:

deploy-bot: docs deploy: staging updated for commit 9a1b2c3 (PR #1988).

jess-product: Great — I'll update the quickstart checklist to include verifying Windows snippets when we bump the next docs release.
